notes.title: VenusBlood RAGNAROK International Demo is available now!
notes.content:
[h3][i]VenusBlood RAGNAROK International[/i] Now Joins Steam Next Fest![/h3][h3][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45596526/3b45c13837bdfb62579151e6c255041ecd3bbf2d.png"][/img]You can now download the English Demo on the Store Page of [i]VenusBlood Ragnarok International[/i].[/h3][h3]This Demo includes the prologue story, with strategic gameplay to be unlocked in the full version.[/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3301900/VenusBlood_RAGNAROK_International"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The Demo is currently English-only. The full version will support Chinese, with Simplified/Traditional Chinese localization being intensively developed by BOKIBOKI![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1][b]About VBRI[/b][/h1][p][i]VenusBlood RAGNAROK International[/i] is the sequel to the acclaimed [i]VenusBlood FRONTIER International[/i], continuing the Norse mythology saga. This story unfolds 500 years after VBFI, and your choices remain pivotal in steering the narrative.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45596526/2fe8c01d42c7cb25a8f4b846b137bd23fe599d98.png"][/img][/p][p]Even if you haven't played VBFI, you can fully enjoy and comprehend this standalone story.[/p][p]VBFI veterans will discover numerous easter eggs referencing the previous work.[/p][p]Compared to the Japanese edition [i]VenusBlood RAGNAROK[/i], the International Version adds substantial content including the new character Vidar.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45596526/65fff54b40cd2386a95ba874fe94f9cbb3f7a628.png"][/img][/p][p]The tactical system of VenusBlood Ragnarok International evolves from VBFI's "Stronghold Conquest" mechanics, delivering richer and deeper party-based combat![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3301900/extras/060331dd59d2bd9ff0f5d41dc4ec41b8_original.png?t=1749626993"][/img]
[/p][h1][b]The STORY[/b][/h1][p]As recorded in the annals of history, a period of war led to the eventual conquering of the Floating Continent of Yggdrasil by the Overlord Loki and the former Goddesses of the Four Seasons—now servant deities—and the founding of the Asgard Empire.[/p][p]500 years have passed since the conquering of Yggdrasil, and the Overlord Loki has vanished. The Goddess Odin whom he had left to rule in his stead has left the mortal realm. Tensions now rise, years after her death. Hostilities between the Demons and Gods of the Empire, rising Spirituality of the Dark Lords and the Goddesses of eld... The flames of war threaten to engulf the realm once more.[/p][p]The belief in Divine Supremacy clashes with that of the Liberation of Demonkind... Opposing views and agendas that could soon spark a bloody civil war.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3301900/extras/GiF-chars-v2.gif?t=1749626993"][/img][/p][p]Though born of the same bloodline as the Goddess Tyrca, the strong demonic blood coursing through Vali's veins gives him prominent demonic features. He is a firm believer in the principles of Divine-Demon Unification, and he has raised an army to fight for these ideals.[/p][p]His sister-in-law, Brunhilde, on the other hand, had recently awakened as a Goddess. She has been tasked with hunting him down, and it is in the chaos of her hunt that Vali chances upon a fated meeting with a youth who shares the same name as the Overlord Loki.[/p][p]"Show me your potential. The potential of an Overlord who would devour the chaos of both the Divine and the Demonic... Yes, as the Overlord Loki did once before. In adversity did he stand, and by his own hand, he conquered all the land."[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45596526/761026a6b7ff0484b2ade63e28c6c9ca63970c82.png"][/img][/p][p]With those words, the youth named Loki handed Vali the Key of Yggdrasil. With it, he gains the power to subjugate goddesses and dominate demons. With it, he takes the first step towards becoming the Conqueror of a new age.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3301900/VenusBlood_RAGNAROK_International"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Trading Cards Are Now Implemented!
notes.content:
Good day, everyone!

Some exciting news today for you collector types!

Yep, Steam Trading Cards have been added to VenusBlood GAIA International!

Certainly a feature that many have asked for, especially since they were implemented for the previous title released on Steam!

We are sorry to have kept you all waiting, and we hope that you will continue to enjoy your time with VenusBlood GAIA International!

notes.title: Patch Ver1.06 is now live
notes.content:
Dear citizens of Energeia, hello:

Thank you for your support and feedback on the game. We have made a series of updates and optimizations in response to the issues previously raised.

[h3]Fixed an issue where a unit that attacked while having the passive skill 'Dimension Slash' was still receiving status ailments from an enemy unit's 'Counter Ailment' passive skill.[/h3]

We will continue to work hard to fix the issues in the game, to provide a smoother and higher quality gaming experience.
Thank you again for your understanding and support of our work. Your valuable feedback is our motivation to improve, and it is also the direction for us to improve the game.
If you have any other opinions and suggestions, you are also welcome to continue to give us feedback in various communities.

We will continue to work hard to create a better Energeia.

We hope you all enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update on VenusBlood GAIA International
notes.content:
Thank you for your unwavering support of the VenusBlood series! 
We have some important updates to share.

[h3]Addressing Performance and Frame Drops[/h3]
Our team is investigating the cause of some performance issues reported by some players on certain hardware. We're committed to delivering a patch to smooth things out as soon as possible.

[h3]Enhancements to Chinese Localization[/h3]
In the coming weeks, we will be releasing patches that improve the Chinese translation quality. Expect the first patch very soon. We deeply apologize for the shortcomings in the Chinese version of VenusBlood GAIA International.

Your gaming experience is our utmost priority. 
We appreciate your patience and understanding as we work to make these essential improvements.
